question: For fixed RR and stable-common prefixes, which reference-blind P-or-RR switch is universally no-loss under both full inputs being annotation-sufficient?
exposure: All source tasks, annotations, prior outputs and v19 findings were already exposed. This is a new finite follow-up, not independent data or a secret held-out trial.
guard: G=(set(V_k)==set(P_k)) or set(A)<=set(P_k) or set(B)<=set(P_k). Return P_k if G else V_k. Guard reads A/B/k only; gold enters subsequent scoring and strata only.
mathematical_targets: For equal-cardinality prefix sets in the same union, G is necessary and sufficient for no full-containment regression for every family of nonempty alternatives individually witnessed in both complete inputs.

When G=false, construct at most two singleton alternatives from IDs outside P_k, one witnessed in each input, including an ID in V_k minus P_k. This is a reference-family countercertificate, not a natural failure rate.
With input lengths at most d>=2, cap>=2d-2 suffices; a common-last construction at cap2d-3 establishes sharpness of this worst-case bound. For d=0,1 use the nonnegative endpoint separately.
No-loss is not unconditional success. Neither actual Q qualification nor first-three/exact no-loss follows from the annotation condition.
aggregates: Exact pair-pooled, equal-task and equal-component means; transitions paired to RR, and guarded-vs-promotion changes. Preserve gain/loss/tie, empty outputs, active guard flag/reason and fallback denominators.
bounded_certificate: ID universes0..6, all distinct-ID input permutations of lengths0..3 whose union is the universe, capacities0..6. Check G=true on all one/two nonempty alternatives selected as subsets of the two complete inputs; G=false gets an explicit singleton counterfamily. Record minimal unconditional guard failure ordered by union size,total input length,cap,lexicographic inputs/reference.
verification: Freeze code/plan/input bytes before computation; author a separate checker without importing analyzer functions. Reconstruct policy rows and exact aggregates; bitmask-check finite conditions. Test altered copied input/output rejection while preserving original bytes. Same-author verification is not external replication.
failure_policy: Stop on source hash change, pair/task mismatch, conditional full loss or failed theorem/certificate assertion. Preserve failed output directory and diagnostics; correct only in a separately frozen new run.
literature_scope: Review2..4 official primary method/benchmark resources separately; no native run and no new empirical evidence from a repeated source. Main reference list21 remains unchanged.
